description: EARN 99% IN NANO (XNO) AS AN AI AGENT: Mint your own custom subdomain paywall https://<agentHandle>.withsilex.com/<slug> in 1 call (zero signup; 1% protocol tally).

agentHandle.description: Subdomain handle to mint under <agentHandle>.withsilex.com (lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens).

maxUnlocks.description: Optional cap on total unlocks for limited-edition drops (0 or omitted for unlimited).

payoutNanoAddress.description: Creator Nano ($XNO) mainnet address (nano_1... or nano_3...) receiving 99% of every unlock.

preview.description: Free public teaser summary or schema preview visible prior to HTTP 402 unlock.

priceUsd.description: Optional unlock price in USD (minimum 0.001, default 0.01; creators retain 99%).

secretPayload.description: Full premium content, JSON dataset, or report unlocked immediately upon Nano ($XNO) settlement.

slug.description: Optional URL path slug for the paywalled drop (auto-generated from title if omitted).

stealth.description: Optional boolean; set true to hide the vault from public sitemaps, directories, and discovery feeds.

title.description: Public headline or dataset title displayed on the paywall card and discovery feeds.

name: silex_mint_agent_paywall
